q_norm: each markets return rolling year
question: what is the rolling return of each markets of each year
sql:
WITH year_spine AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', DATEADD(year, -seq4(), CURRENT_DATE())) AS yr
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 10))
),
market_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_year,
        MARKETS.NAME AS market_name,
        SUM(TRANSACTIONS.TOTALVALUE) AS total_return
    FROM FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.MARKETS ON TRANSACTIONS.MARKETID = MARKETS.MARKETID
    WHERE TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP), MARKETS.NAME
)
SELECT 
    year_spine.yr AS "Year",
    market_returns.market_name AS "Market",
    COALESCE(market_returns.total_return, 0) AS "Rolling Return"
FROM year_spine
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT NAME FROM FAR_TRANS.MARKETS) AS markets
LEFT JOIN market_returns 
    ON year_spine.yr = market_returns.transaction_year 
    AND markets.NAME = market_returns.market_name
WHERE year_spine.yr <= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE())
ORDER BY year_spine.yr, markets.NAME
LIMIT 10000

q_norm: all each market markets nasdaq particular xirr year
question: what is the xirr of each year for this particular market: "NASDAQ All Markets"
sql:
WITH year_spine AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', DATEADD(year, -seq4(), CURRENT_DATE())) AS yr
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 10))
),
market_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_year,
        MARKETS.NAME AS market_name,
        TRANSACTIONS.CUSTOMERID,
        TRANSACTIONS.ISIN,
        TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTIONTYPE,
        TRANSACTIONS.TOTALVALUE,
        TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP
    FROM FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.MARKETS ON TRANSACTIONS.MARKETID = MARKETS.MARKETID
    WHERE MARKETS.NAME = 'NASDAQ All Markets'
      AND TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL
),
cashflows AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        market_name,
        CUSTOMERID,
        ISIN,
        TIMESTAMP,
        CASE 
            WHEN TRANSACTIONTYPE = 'Buy' THEN -1 * TOTALVALUE
            WHEN TRANSACTIONTYPE = 'Sell' THEN TOTALVALUE
            ELSE 0
        END AS cashflow
    FROM market_transactions
),
xirr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        market_name,
        SUM(cashflow) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMERID), 0) AS xirr_proxy
    FROM cashflows
    GROUP BY transaction_year, market_name
)
SELECT 
    year_spine.yr AS "Year",
    COALESCE(xirr_calc.xirr_proxy, 0) AS "XIRR"
FROM year_spine
LEFT JOIN xirr_calc 
    ON year_spine.yr = xirr_calc.transaction_year
WHERE year_spine.yr <= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE())
ORDER BY year_spine.yr

q_norm: 2018 2022 all asstes avg chart column create each from market markets name nasdaq number particular profitibility table which xirr year
question:
what is the xirr of each year for this particular market: "NASDAQ All Markets" from 2018 to 2022 
create a table chart which the column name year, avg profitibility, number of asstes
sql:
WITH year_spine AS (
    SELECT DATEADD(year, seq4(), '2018-01-01'::DATE) AS yr
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 5))
),
market_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_year,
        TRANSACTIONS.CUSTOMERID,
        TRANSACTIONS.ISIN,
        TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTIONTYPE,
        TRANSACTIONS.TOTALVALUE,
        TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP
    FROM FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.MARKETS ON TRANSACTIONS.MARKETID = MARKETS.MARKETID
    WHERE MARKETS.NAME = 'NASDAQ All Markets'
      AND TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP >= '2018-01-01'::DATE
      AND TRANSACTIONS.TIMESTAMP < '2023-01-01'::DATE
),
cashflows AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        CUSTOMERID,
        ISIN,
        TIMESTAMP,
        CASE 
            WHEN TRANSACTIONTYPE = 'Buy' THEN -1 * TOTALVALUE
            WHEN TRANSACTIONTYPE = 'Sell' THEN TOTALVALUE
            ELSE 0
        END AS cashflow
    FROM market_transactions
),
xirr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        SUM(cashflow) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMERID), 0) AS xirr_proxy
    FROM cashflows
    GROUP BY transaction_year
),
profitability_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        AVG(TOTALVALUE) AS avg_profitability
    FROM market_transactions
    WHERE TRANSACTIONTYPE = 'Sell'
    GROUP BY transaction_year
),
asset_count AS (
    SELECT 
        transaction_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ISIN) AS number_of_assets
    FROM market_transactions
    GROUP BY transaction_year
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM year_spine.yr) AS "Year",
    COALESCE(xirr_calc.xirr_proxy, 0) AS "XIRR",
    COALESCE(profitability_calc.avg_profitability, 0) AS "Avg Profitability",
    COALESCE(asset_count.number_of_assets, 0) AS "Number of Assets"
FROM year_spine
LEFT JOIN xirr_calc ON year_spine.yr = xirr_calc.transaction_year
LEFT JOIN profitability_calc ON year_spine.yr = profitability_calc.transaction_year
LEFT JOIN asset_count ON year_spine.yr = asset_count.transaction_year
ORDER BY year_spine.yr
LIMIT 100

q_norm: across as bar chart comparison entire has highest market return returns showing timeline which
question: Market returns comparison across entire timeline as bar chart showing which market has highest return
sql:
WITH market_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        MARKETS.MARKETID,
        MARKETS.NAME AS market_name,
        AVG(LIMIT_PRICES.PROFITABILITY) AS avg_return
    FROM FAR_TRANS.MARKETS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION ON ASSET_INFORMATION.MARKETID = MARKETS.MARKETID
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES ON LIMIT_PRICES.ISIN = ASSET_INFORMATION.ISIN
    WHERE LIMIT_PRICES.PROFITABILITY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY MARKETS.MARKETID, MARKETS.NAME
)
SELECT 
    market_name AS "Market",
    avg_return AS "Average Return"
FROM market_returns
ORDER BY avg_return DESC

q_norm: across all as bar chart countries horizontal markets performance return top
question: Top 5 countries by return performance across all markets as horizontal bar chart
sql:
WITH country_performance AS (
    SELECT MARKETS.COUNTRY, LIMIT_PRICES.PROFITABILITY
    FROM FAR_TRANS.MARKETS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION ON MARKETS.MARKETID = ASSET_INFORMATION.MARKETID
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES ON ASSET_INFORMATION.ISIN = LIMIT_PRICES.ISIN
    WHERE MARKETS.COUNTRY IS NOT NULL AND LIMIT_PRICES.PROFITABILITY IS NOT NULL
),
country_avg_performance AS (
    SELECT COUNTRY, AVG(PROFITABILITY) AS avg_return_performance
    FROM country_performance
    GROUP BY COUNTRY
)
SELECT COUNTRY AS "Country", avg_return_performance AS "Return Performance"
FROM country_avg_performance
ORDER BY avg_return_performance DESC
LIMIT 5

q_norm: count customer id unique
question: give me the count of unique customer id
sql:
WITH mtf_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        MARKETS.COUNTRY,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TRANSACTIONS.CUSTOMERID) AS customer_count
    FROM FAR_TRANS.MARKETS
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION ON ASSET_INFORMATION.MARKETID = MARKETS.MARKETID
    INNER JOIN FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS ON TRANSACTIONS.ISIN = ASSET_INFORMATION.ISIN
    WHERE UPPER(ASSET_INFORMATION.ASSETCATEGORY) = 'MTF'
      AND MARKETS.COUNTRY IS NOT NULL
